_comment: Declarative definition of the Links CMS schema — the shape every site's base
must have. scripts/init-base.py builds a new base from this and then writes
This file is the template; airtable-schema.json is per-site and generated.
Never hand-edit the schema file, and never put a base ID in here.
Link fields are declared only on the child side. Airtable auto-creates the
symmetric field on the parent, which is why Sections has no link fields
listed but ends up with Websites/People/Projects on it.
`key` is the stable name the sync uses (schema.tables.X.fields.key); `name`
is the Airtable display name and may be renamed freely afterwards.

tables.name: Sections
tables.description: Collapsible sections on the links site. Order and Open drive how the page renders.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Section heading shown on the page.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description: URL fragment / DOM id. Lowercase, hyphenated, unique.

fields.name: Order
fields.description: Sort order of sections on the page.

tables.name: Websites
tables.description: Simple link cards. Rows flagged Favorite also appear in the favorites strip at the top of the page.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Link label shown on the card.

fields.name: Search
fields.description: Extra keywords for the on-page search. Falls back to the lowercased name if blank.

fields.name: Favorite
fields.description: Show in the favorites strip at the top of the page.

fields.name: Favorite Order
fields.description: Sort order within the favorites strip.

fields.name: Section
fields.description: The section this link appears under. Leave blank for a favorites-only link.

tables.name: People
tables.description: Person cards. Every profile field is optional — blanks are skipped when the card renders.

fields.name: Note
fields.description: Short qualifier shown after the name, e.g. a role or (fictional).

fields.name: Section
fields.description: The section this person appears under.

tables.name: Projects
tables.description: Project cards. Live and repo links live in Project Resources so a project can carry any number of links.

fields.name: Emoji
fields.description: Optional emoji prefix shown before the name.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Drives the colour of the status dot.

fields.name: Status Label
fields.description: Free text shown next to the dot, e.g. Server side only.

fields.name: Section
fields.description: The section this project appears under.

tables.name: Project Resources
tables.description: Links belonging to a project — Live, Repo, and anything else such as a sheet or a doc.

fields.name: Label
fields.description: Short link label, e.g. Live, Repo, Sheet.

fields.name: Project
fields.description: The project this resource belongs to.
